currentParagraphText: “You have a bright future ahead of you,” Jake said, giving the kid a wide smile as he ruffled his hair. With a final goodbye to the others, Jake left the house through the front door, briefly stopped by his own little residence to pick up a few things he’d left there before promptly shooting off to the teleportation center to quickly return to Haven.
